title: Swap the flour
cover_text: Equal weights, *swap the flour*, cake becomes almond cream

dishes.name: Pound cake
dishes.text: *A pound of each*. Creamed butter holds air, flour and egg set around it.

dishes.name: Almond cream
dishes.text: *Ground almonds* instead of flour. No gluten, so it bakes soft in a tart.

sheet_text: Wheat flour gives *a cake*. Almonds give a tart filling.
sources: https://bakerbettie.com/mastering-perfect-pound-cake/ (original pound cake: 1 lb each of sugar, butter, eggs and flour; leavened only by air creamed into the batter)
https://uglyducklingbakery.com/baking-ratios (pound cake: equal amounts of butter, sugar, eggs and flour)
https://www.cooksinfo.com/creme-damandes (crème d'amande: equal parts sugar, butter, ground almonds, eggs; 100 g each)
https://www.bakinglikeachef.com/almond-cream-filling-creme-damande/ (almond cream: equal weights butter, sugar, egg, ground almonds; no flour)
https://www.spatuladesserts.com/frangipane-almond-cream (classic almond cream: equal amounts of 4 ingredients, 100 g each)
